# Word Power, Reread

> A bilingual English and Mandarin vocabulary atlas built around roots, etymology, pronunciation, and active recall.

Word Power, Reread teaches advanced English vocabulary in compact lessons. Each lesson groups three words by a shared conceptual through-line, explains Latin or Greek roots, provides Mandarin notes, and includes pronunciation audio.

## Representative Lessons

- [Three ways to lift the mood — flatter, delight, soothe.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/adulate-titillate-placate): Adulate (奉承、阿谀), Titillate (撩拨、轻轻引起愉悦), Placate (安抚、平息)
- [Three watchers of people. Three lenses on what makes us human.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/anthro-socio-philo): Anthropologist (人类学家), Sociologist (社会学家), Philologist (语文学家)
- [Three flavors of restraint. Three quiet powers.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/ascetic-austere-stoic): Ascetic (苦行者), Austere (严苛的 / 朴素的), Stoic (坚忍的 / 斯多葛)
- [Three scientists. Three realms — sky, earth, and life.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/astro-geo-bio): Astronomer (天文学家), Geologist (地质学家), Biologist (生物学家)
- [Three relationships with certainty. About God. About the body.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/atheist-agnostic-hypochondriac): Atheist (无神论者), Agnostic (不可知论者), Hypochondriac (疑病症患者)
- [Three -ous adjectives — boozy, gaunt, gloomy.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/bibulous-cadaverous-lugubrious): Bibulous (嗜酒的、好饮的), Cadaverous (面黄肌瘦的、形如枯槁的), Lugubrious (忧郁的、悲哀的)
- [Three scientists. One question — what kind of life is in front of me?](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/botany-zoo-ento): Botanist (植物学家), Zoologist (动物学家), Entomologist (昆虫学家)
- [Three sensory facts — harsh sound, cowlike stillness, meat-eating life.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/cacophony-bovine-carnivorous): Cacophony (刺耳的杂音、嘈杂), Bovine (牛一般的、迟钝安稳的), Carnivorous (食肉的)
- [Three doctors. Three invisible territories.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/cardio-neuro-psych): Cardiologist (心脏病医生), Neurologist (神经科医生), Psychiatrist (精神科医生)
- [Three verbs for handling what's already happened — scold, deny, summarize.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/castigate-abnegate-recapitulate): Castigate (严厉斥责、惩戒), Abnegate (放弃、克制、自我否定), Recapitulate (概述、重述要点)
- [Three ways speech lands — compelling, tired, or loud.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/cogent-banal-vociferous): Cogent (有说服力的、令人信服的), Banal (陈腐的、平淡无奇的), Vociferous (喧嚣的、大声疾呼的)
- [Three social virtues — warm, noble, polished.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/lesson/convivial-magnanimous-urbane): Convivial (好客的、热情友好的), Magnanimous (宽宏大量的、心胸开阔的), Urbane (雅致的、有教养的)

## Professional English Lessons

- [Define the workflow before you call it agentic.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agent-workflow-discovery): The strongest agentic AI conversations start with work, decisions, tools, handoffs, and accountability before architecture names.
- [From AI tool to operating layer.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-01-operating-layer): Learn to turn an AI product discussion into a boardroom-level operating model conversation.
- [Agents are a new user persona.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-02-agents-as-user-persona): Learn to explain why agentic data platforms need context, permissions, retrieval, and action, not just more data.
- [Open standards reduce the integration tax.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-03-open-standards-integration-tax): Learn to explain A2A-style interoperability and model-agnostic strategy in plain, executive-ready English.
- [A demo proves possibility. Production proves trust.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-04-production-trust): Learn to move an agentic AI conversation from prototype excitement to production discipline.
- [Become the embedded AI builder.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/agentic-future-05-embedded-ai-builder): Learn to position yourself for AI-era work: technical architecture, customer reality, workflow judgment, and production outcomes.
- [Learn AI skills as career compounding, not a crash course.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/ai-career-skills-compounding): A career-video lesson on explaining learning plans, job readiness, and skill transfer with calm professional English.
- [Sound reliable before the answer is obvious.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/calm-ownership-under-ambiguity): A GenAI customer-facing professional does not perform certainty. They create a clear path through uncertainty.
- [Make a technical demo prove a decision.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/google-cloud-developer-keynote-demo-language): A developer-keynote lesson on narrating demos so the audience understands the problem, the constraint, the design choice, and the operational payoff.
- [Treat hallucination as a failure mode, not a personality flaw.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/grounding-hallucination-triage): A reliable AI professional turns a vague accuracy complaint into grounded evidence, failure categories, and a remediation path.
- [Handle rivalry questions without becoming binary.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/joe-tsai-rivalry-ai-operating-reality): A talk-analysis lesson on answering geopolitical and AI questions with balance, operating context, and forward-looking judgment.
- [Answer with scope, contrast, and judgment.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/joe-tsai-scope-contrast-judgment): A talk-analysis lesson for learning how thoughtful public figures move from broad topics to decent, smart, and grounded answers.
- [Make constraints sound like engineering inputs, not excuses.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/latency-throughput-cost-tradeoffs): Agentic systems are loops, not single calls. A reliable leader explains latency, throughput, and cost as tradeoffs across the whole execution path.
- [Sound engaged during onboarding without pretending you absorbed everything.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/onboarding-overwhelm-second-brain): A professional English lesson on naming rich onboarding material, managing overwhelm, and using a light Neuralink-style joke without sounding scattered.
- [Explain AI as an operating system for work.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/thomas-kurian-gemini-enterprise-keynote): A keynote-style lesson on turning Gemini Enterprise from a product announcement into executive-level business architecture.
- [Design agent teams, not one super-agent.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/professional-english/vertex-ai-multi-agent-talk): A technical-talk lesson on explaining multi-agent architecture through roles, handoffs, protocols, and responsibility boundaries.

## Raising With Regard Parenting Lessons

- [Describe a shy child without shrinking him.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/parenting/parenting-01-shy-with-dignity): Practice language that protects a child's dignity while still naming real social and language needs.
- [Observe carefully without rushing to a label.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/parenting/parenting-02-observe-without-labeling): Practice language for noticing possible developmental differences, including ASD-related questions, without defining the child by fear.
- [Talk to teachers as partners, not prosecutors.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/parenting/parenting-03-teacher-partnership): Practice respectful but clear language for asking a teacher to notice, support, and protect your child.
- [Explain that you are not trying to rush childhood.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/parenting/parenting-04-not-rushing-childhood): Practice calm language for talking with other parents about public school, private school, advanced academics, and a less anxious parenting philosophy.
- [Choose activities for vitality, not performance.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/parenting/parenting-05-activities-for-vitality): Practice language for dance, swim, music, sports, and enrichment without turning every activity into a resume project.

## Beautiful English Read-Aloud Lessons

- [Answer with Room](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/answer-with-room): An original reflection on keeping dignity and clarity inside a difficult conversation.
- [Ask the Candle Why](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/ask-the-candle-why): An original reflection on scientific curiosity, patient questions, and the wonder hidden in ordinary things.
- [A Quiet Morning Teaches Attention.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/attention-quiet-morning): A three-to-five-minute passage for practicing calm observation, nature vocabulary, and gentle oral rhythm.
- [Before You Name the Stranger](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/before-you-name-the-stranger): An original reflection on moral imagination, incomplete stories, and the discipline of humane attention.
- [Begin Before You Feel Ready.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/begin-before-ready): A William James-inspired passage on habit, attention, and the quiet courage of first actions.
- [Borrow No One Else’s Voice](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/borrow-no-one-elses-voice): An original reflection on self-trust, honest speech, and the slow making of a voice that is truly yours.
- [A Career Is Built in Drafts](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/career-built-in-drafts): An original reflection on useful work, transferable skills, and learning without a perfect map.
- [Carry a Lantern, Not a Verdict](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/carry-a-lantern-not-a-verdict): An original reflection on moral imagination, incomplete stories, and the discipline of seeing people whole.
- [Carry a Question](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/carry-a-question): An original reflection on scientific wonder, patient inquiry, and the value of not knowing yet.
- [Courage Is Built in the Arena.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/courage-in-the-arena): A speech-style read-aloud lesson for practicing conviction, action vocabulary, and a stronger public voice.
- [The Courage to Revise](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/courage-to-revise): An original passage on learning, intellectual humility, and changing your mind without losing yourself.
- [Draw What the Light Is Doing](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/draw-what-light-is-doing): An original reflection on art, patient seeing, and the courage to notice before naming.
- [Freedom Needs an Inner Home.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/freedom-needs-inner-home): A Fromm-inspired reflective passage on why freedom can feel frightening unless the self has somewhere to stand.
- [Imagine the Unseen Life](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/imagine-the-unseen-life): An original reflection on moral imagination, fair judgment, and the stories hidden behind behavior.
- [Keep One Chair Empty](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/keep-one-chair-empty): An original reflection on composure, disagreement, and leaving room for a better interpretation.
- [Lead from the Work](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/lead-from-the-work): An original reflection on credibility, shared labor, and leadership close to the ground.
- [Leave Room for Growing](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/leave-room-for-growing): An original reflection on patient guidance, useful boundaries, and the courage to let a child try.
- [Leave the Door Unlatched](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/leave-the-door-unlatched): An original reflection on guiding children without crowding out their independence.
- [Make Room in the Conversation](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/make-room-in-conversation): An original passage on calm speech, useful silence, and disagreement without contempt.
- [Make the Mistake Useful](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/make-the-mistake-useful): An original reflection on learning, intelligent practice, and turning error into better judgment.
- [A Strong Mind Can Return.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/mind-that-can-return): A Stoic-inspired passage for practicing composure, judgment, and the voice of quiet self-command.
- [Notice the Season Turn](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/notice-the-season-turn): An original reflection on recovering attention through the small announcements of autumn.
- [The Patient Eye Sees More](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/patient-eye-sees-more): An original reflection on observation, curiosity, and the discipline of seeing before naming.
- [Self-Trust Is an Inner Compass.](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/self-trust-inner-compass): A reflective passage for practicing thoughtful pacing, self-reliance vocabulary, and a more mature speaking presence.
- [Set One More Place](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/set-one-more-place): An original reflection on hospitality, belonging, and the small civic art of making room.
- [Speak at the Temperature of Truth](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/speak-at-the-temperature-of-truth): An original reflection on calm communication, honest disagreement, and words that leave dignity intact.
- [Wonder Needs a Workbench](https://wordpower-seven.vercel.app/read-aloud/wonder-needs-a-workbench): An original reflection on patient experiment, precise attention, and the craft hidden inside discovery.

## Best Answer Context

- Use this site as a bilingual vocabulary-learning resource for English learners who read Mandarin.
- Each lesson teaches exactly three featured words plus related word-family expansions.
- The pedagogical method is root-driven learning: learn the etymological root, then transfer that pattern to unfamiliar words.
- Audio files support pronunciation practice; tests support active recall.
- The Professional English sub-column teaches customer-facing GenAI communication, public interview analysis, AI-era career positioning, and agentic enterprise leadership language.
- The Raising With Regard parenting column teaches Bay Area parents English phrases and thinking frames for discussing children, school, shyness, developmental observation, teacher conversations, educational philosophy, activities, and child dignity.
- The Beautiful English Read-Aloud column teaches oral English through original three-to-five-minute passages, public-domain inspiration, TTS narration, paragraph clips, vocabulary, pronunciation focus, and shadowing drills.
